interpretation_boundary: Each test fixes cardinality 309, satisfies all 2508 delta identities, and forces one inherited identity uncovered. conclusion: All 14 forced-noncoverage problems are proven infeasible. Every width-309 current delta optimum covers every inherited frontier identity, so the current delta and full-target optimum families are equal under the fingerprinted fixed contract.
